notes: Access: direct fetch worked with no blocking (HTTP 200 on robots.txt, homepage, all category pages); robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, generic '*' group only, no restriction beyond standard crawl-delay. Platform: Magento (Lals Group / Homes r Us UAE). Qty verified via the Magento layered-nav toolbar text 'Items X - Y of N results for <Category>' on each category page; this is the genuine filtered result count (not a cached/inflated products_count API), cross-verified twice by exhaustion per Rule 1: Dinner Plates (139 total, page 6 of 6 shows items 121-139) and Candle Holders (288 total, page 12 of 12 shows items 265-288) both match ceil(total/24)==page_count exactly. No precedent company on this project (fresh UAE retailer, first Home R Us extraction). Rule 0 gains: Lighting traversed depth-first with String Lights included as a lighting-type item despite living under the 'Home Accessories' nav node. 'Garden Lamps & Candles' (labelled as if lighting+candles) and 'Wickers' (labelled as if furniture) were both re-classified by actual product-type inspection - the former is entirely bamboo/rattan garden lanterns, the latter entirely wicker/grass planters - per Rule 0 product-type-beats-name. All mirror types included (floor/wall/bathroom). Clocks included as a single childless leaf. Decorative metal curtain rods and curtain tiebacks included per explicit brief carve-out. Rule 0.6 overlap: tissue box covers/holders appear as three separate, non-identical listings across different nav branches (Home Accessories: 2 items, Dining>Table Linen 'Tissue Holders': 27 items, Bath&Laundry 'Bathroom Accessories': 31 items) - kept as three distinct rows since counts differ (not the same URL/listing), overlap documented rather than dropped. Exclusions applied: Furniture (all), Rugs/Carpets/Door Mats, Throws & Cushions, Bedding, Towels/Bathrobes/Laundry, Bathroom Storage racks/cabinets/organizers, Bathroom Furniture/Vanity, Kitchen appliances/cookware/knives/bakeware, Food Storage/pantry, Kitchen Organizers, Cutlery, Table Linen (covers/runners/placemats), Curtains fabric & Window Blinds, Artificial Flowers & Plants, Garden Pots & Stands (site titles this 'Plant Stands' - functional furniture, not a planter), Coasters/Napkin&Accessories page (mixed roll-up of napkin sets [textile, excluded] and napkin rings/holders [decor, in-scope] on one 76-item URL with no facet to isolate the decor subset - dropped per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' rather than padding the whole count), Candles (title confirms 'Scented Candles' - excluded per Home Fragrance/scented-candle exclusion), Home Fragrance diffusers/potpourri/air fresheners, Toothbrush Holders & Tumblers/Soap Dishes & Dispensers/Toilet Brush Holders (personal-care/cleaning, not decorative), Waste Bins (storage, redirects into Kitchen Organizing), Shower Curtains & Rods (bathroom textile/fixture hardware), Vacuum Flasks & Bottles (functional travel drinkware, not tableware), Cheeseboards and Food Warmers & Casseroles (functional cookware/serving-heat items, not decorative tableware).
